name: gomex
description: Atrium clients and their shared packages (docs/adr/001-client-architecture.md). The server, deploy and the Electron shell are outside the workspaces.

scripts.test: npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test desktop/tests/*.test.cjs && node desktop/check-i18n.js
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w @gomex/desktop-ui && npm run build-storybook -w @gomex/ui-web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
